description: Implementation of the Application class managing system events, lifecycle states, and command line interactions in the starboard namespace.

classes.name: Application
classes.description: Manages application lifecycle, event dispatching, and command line processing within the starboard platform.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Initializes and runs the application with command line arguments and optional link data.

methods.name: RunLoop
methods.description: Main event loop processing system events until termination.

methods.name: DispatchAndDelete
methods.description: Dispatches an event and manages its lifecycle, updating application state accordingly.

methods.name: HandleEventAndUpdateState
methods.description: Handles a specific event, updates application state, and manages suspend/resume callbacks.

methods.name: CreateInitialEvent
methods.description: Creates initial preload or start events with command line arguments.
